title: Billie Eilish - No Time To Die (Toxiqsou Remix)

lines.l: That blood you've made is just the blood you want
You were my life, my life is far away from pain
Was I stupid to love you?
Was I a right place to fall? Was it obvious to everybody else that I've fallen for and I, you were never on my side
Fool me once, fool me twice
There's just no time to die
Another thing that you see is
To learn that I've fallen for a lie
You were never on my side
You fooled me once, fooled me twice
Now you'll never see me cry
